The standard command from the Ollama Docker docs is:

```powershell
docker run -d --gpus=all -v ollama:/root/.ollama -p 11434:11434 --name ollama ollama/ollama
```

- `--gpus=all` exposes all NVIDIA GPUs to the container.
- `-v ollama:/root/.ollama` stores models in a named volume so they persist.
- `-p 11434:11434` publishes the Ollama API on port 11434.

This requires:
- An NVIDIA driver on the host.
- Docker with GPU support. On Windows, use Docker Desktop with the WSL 2 backend and an up-to-date NVIDIA driver. On Linux, install the NVIDIA Container Toolkit.

To confirm the GPUs are visible inside the container, run:

```powershell
docker exec -it ollama nvidia-smi
```

I don't know anything about this particular project's setup beyond what you've told me. This is the general Ollama guidance, so check it against any project-specific compose files or scripts you have.
